actions.name: convert_csv_to_json
actions.description: This function reads a CSV string and converts it into JSON array format.

actions.name: convert_json_to_csv
actions.description: This function reads a JSON array and converts it into CSV format.

actions.name: convert_excel_to_csv
actions.description: Converts an Excel file (.xlsx or .xls) into CSV text.

actions.name: read_csv_file
actions.description: Reads a CSV file (for example an email attachment) into rows you can loop over.

actions.name: create_csv_file
actions.description: Turns a list of rows into a .csv file you can attach to an email or upload.

actions.name: convert_csv_to_excel
actions.description: Turns CSV text into an Excel (.xlsx) file.

actions.name: filter_csv_rows
actions.description: Keeps only the rows where a column matches a condition.

actions.name: sort_csv_rows
actions.description: Sorts the rows by one column, as text, numbers or dates.

actions.name: remove_duplicate_csv_rows
actions.description: Removes repeated rows from CSV text, comparing whole rows or chosen columns.

actions.name: select_csv_columns
actions.description: Keeps, reorders or removes columns in CSV text.

actions.name: merge_csv
actions.description: Stacks several CSVs into one, matching columns by name.

actions.name: split_csv
actions.description: Splits CSV text into smaller CSVs with a set number of rows each.
